Mara (CSM): Heads-up: NovaMarket (LatAm) reached out — new Analytics + Support pods want to adopt KB embeddings + realtime chat summarization. They're asking for an on-prem/private control plane because of PCI scope. Expecting ~4x current embedding QPS and intermittent spikes for campaigns. Renewal in 30 days.

Jorge (CS Ops): Got it. What are their current numbers? Are they on Hosted or Dedicated?

Mara (CSM): Currently on Hosted API (NA region) with modest usage: ~15k embeds/day baseline. They project 60k/day post-ramp, peak concurrent QPS ~300. Also want streaming summarization <200ms per chunk.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Realtime <200ms is tight for on-prem depending on hardware. Which embedding + summarization models?

Ravi (AE): They told us: `embed-compact-v1` for KB + `summarize-pro` for streaming. They're open to quantized variants but want a pre-rollout quality check.

Zoe (Product): Product note: on-prem will need Private with local KMS and audit logs. We should prepare the Private checklist and the eval matrix for summarization quality/regression.

Kai (Infra): For on-prem appliance + Dedicated pool sizing we'll need hardware specs from the customer. Rough estimate: to hit 300 QPS for embeddings + streaming nodes, suggest 4x medium GPU workers initially. Provision ETA depends on region and customer infra readiness.

Jorge (CS Ops): I'll spin up a sizing worksheet and quote banding for 3 scenarios: Hosted fallback (EU), Private small (4 medium), Private full (8 medium + HA).

Mara (CSM): Customer contacts: @latam-carlos (PM), @latam-ana (infra). They want a kickoff in 4 business days. Can we target a pilot within 3 weeks? Renewal pressure — if we don't show progress, they may request discounts.

Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a preflight eval and a lightweight streaming harness. Example config I plan to run against their sample transcripts:
```
# streaming summarization harness snippet
model: summarize-pro-quantized
stream: true
chunk_size: 512
max_latency_ms: 200
concurrency: 16
metrics: [rougeL, latency_p95, token_cost]
```

Zoe (Product): Also capture telemetry events for fallbacks, cache hit rates, and summary length distributions. That will help Optimize identify cost/levers.

Kai (Infra): Quick feasibility: we can support Private with local KMS and audit logs. On-prem install window ~12 business days + customer infra prep. If they need faster, propose staged: Hosted EU fallback -> Private install.

Ravi (AE): I'll prepare a renewal upsell play: multi-region + private SLA + onboarding services. Drafting amendment to include data residency and HSM clause.

deploy-bot: Created ticket CS-6601 (NovaMarket LatAm KB + streaming pilot). Reminder scheduled for 2796027000 (kickoff in 4 business days).

Jorge (CS Ops): Action items: 1) Confirm sample data and infra contacts 2) Run preflight eval on their sample set 3) Produce quotes for 3 scenarios 4) Draft rollout timeline and pilot success metrics.

Mara (CSM): I uploaded sample transcripts and contacts to CS-6601. I'll confirm kickoff time with client. Prioritizing because renewal in 30 days.

Zoe (Product): Risk note: if Private install slips past renewal date, they'll push for extended concession. Marking as high-risk upsell.

Kai (Infra): Marking infra path as critical. I'll start the provisioning checklist and ask legal for KMS requirements.

Mara (CSM): Thanks team. Quick sync tomorrow 10am PT to finalize quote and pilot plan. :thumbsup:
